label: run current file
command: case "$ZED_LANGUAGE" in Python) python3 "$ZED_FILE" ;; Lua) lua "$ZED_FILE" ;; "Shell Script") bash "$ZED_FILE" ;; C) binary=$(mktemp /tmp/zed-run-c.XXXXXX) && cc -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -std=c11 "$ZED_FILE" -o "$binary" && "$binary" ;; "C++") binary=$(mktemp /tmp/zed-run-cpp.XXXXXX) && c++ -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -std=c++20 "$ZED_FILE" -o "$binary" && "$binary" ;; *) echo "Unsupported language: $ZED_LANGUAGE"; exit 1 ;; esac
